meta.title: Next festival
meta.description: Shows the soonest festival across the regions you pick and the days remaining, in a positionable floating badge that never shares a slot with the solar-term plugin. Choose several regions and one of four corners in this plugin's own page: sidebar Plugins > Installed > Next festival > Festival region. Fixed, lunar, Islamic-calendar and weekday-rule dates are computed locally with no network access; a few ethnic and religious festivals follow published year tables and are marked as approximate. The choice is saved in this browser only.
